body.title: Statistical Data Analyst for Experimental Biology Data
body.aiReason: Skills (R, Python, stats, visualization) match core expertise; job aligns with data analysis/visualization focus; description appears genuine, no red flags.
body.description:
Looking for a statistical/data analyst to support several experimental biology projects.
What we need
Review experimental datasets and study design
Determine the appropriate statistical analyses
Test for significant effects, group differences, and interactions where relevant
Identify potential issues or limitations in the data
Produce high-quality, publication-ready data visualizations
Clearly summarize and interpret the statistical findings
Skills required
Strong statistics background
Experience with biological, biomedical, neuroscience, physiology, animal, or similar research data
Strong understanding of experimental design
Excellent scientific data visualization skills
Proficiency in R, GraphPad Prism, Python, or similar software
Ability to communicate statistical results clearly to researchers
Project
Initial work: approximately 2 datasets
Estimated 15–20 hours
Potential for ongoing projects
When applying
Please include:
A brief description of relevant experience
Examples of biological/scientific datasets you have analyzed
Examples of figures or data visualizations you have created
Statistical and visualization software you use
